verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Omarchy's default firewall leaves port 53317 open for LocalSend. That implies the distro accommodates LocalSend-based wireless file transfer between nearby devices, but the docs never describe how to use it, how devices are paired, or whether it is preinstalled. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that LocalSend (or Bluetooth file transfer) ships and how to use it, device pairing workflow, keyboard/menu integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
